subject: amber14 cuda code does not work

messages.author: Carlos
messages.body:
Hi dear all.
I have installed amber14 with GPU code. I have installed serial amber14
with AmberTools15 successfully and also CUDA version. When installation is
complete, I get the message: Amber14 CUDA version is completed. It seems
looks well, but when I run pmemd.cuda, I get this advertisement:
cudaGetDeviceCount failed CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA
runtime version
I have checked cuda libs and they are in /usr/local/cuda-7.5/lib64 and it
seems is ok.
could somebody help me please?
Thanks in advance

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Aug 22, 2020, Carlos wrote:
>
>cudaGetDeviceCount failed CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA
>runtime version
Can you run any GPU programs? This message doesn't appear to have anything
to do with Amber. It is saying that you probably need to update your driver.
Do a Google search on "cudaGetDeviceCount failed CUDA driver version is
insufficient for CUDA runtime version"
and see if the advice offered there helps.
...dac

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
For CUDA 7.5 you will need driver version >= 352.31.
https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/index.html
Ensure you are running at least that version. Then check you can run a
CUDA program by e.g. compiling and running the deviceQueryDrv SDK
sample.
-Dan
